senses.en: bad-tempered and silent, often refusing to talk

example.en: The sulky child refused to answer any questions.
example.zh: 那个闹脾气的孩子不肯回答任何问题。

senses.en: a formal legal contract or agreement

example.en: The apprentice signed an indenture with the workshop owner.
example.zh: 学徒与作坊主签订了一份契约。

senses.en: to bind someone, such as an apprentice, by contract

example.en: Many immigrants were indentured to work on plantations.
example.zh: 许多移民因契约而被迫在种植园做工。

senses.en: treatment of injury or disease using exercise, massage and other physical methods

example.en: After the surgery, he needed months of physiotherapy to walk again.
example.zh: 手术后，他需要几个月的理疗才能重新行走。

senses.en: producing no profit or useful result

example.en: The discussion became a profitless argument.
example.zh: 讨论变成了毫无成效的争论。

senses.en: throughout the whole of a period of time

example.en: It rained during the night.
example.zh: 夜里下了雨。

senses.en: surrounded by or in the middle of several people or things

example.en: She found her keys among the books.
example.zh: 她在书堆中找到了钥匙。

senses.en: shared by or involving members of a group

example.en: They divided the cake among the children.
example.zh: 他们把蛋糕分给了孩子们。

senses.en: to meet a requirement, standard, or condition
senses.zh: 满足；符合（要求、标准或条件）

example.en: The design must satisfy all safety requirements.
example.zh: 该设计必须满足所有安全要求。

senses.en: to make someone pleased by giving them what they want

example.en: The explanation did not satisfy the customer.
example.zh: 这个解释没有让顾客满意。

senses.en: to fulfill a need or desire

example.en: This answer may satisfy your curiosity.
example.zh: 这个答案也许能满足你的好奇心。

senses.en: Something given in return for good work, help, or service.

example.en: She got a reward for finding the missing dog.
example.zh: 她因找到走失的狗而获得了一笔报酬。

senses.en: To give something to someone because they have done good work or helped.

example.en: The school rewarded her with a prize for her essay.
example.zh: 学校因她的文章而奖励了她一个奖项。

senses.en: relating to diplomacy or the relations between countries

example.en: The two countries resumed diplomatic talks last month.
example.zh: 两国上个月恢复了外交会谈。

senses.en: able to deal with sensitive matters tactfully and without offending people

example.en: She gave a diplomatic answer that avoided criticizing anyone.
example.zh: 她给出了一个得体的回答，没有批评任何人。

senses.en: a very strong feeling or emotion

example.en: She talked about the project with great passion.
example.zh: 她满怀激情地谈论这个项目。

senses.en: a strong love of or enthusiasm for something
senses.zh: 酷爱；对某事物的强烈兴趣

example.en: He has a lifelong passion for astronomy.
example.zh: 他对天文学怀有终生的热爱。

senses.en: strong romantic love or sexual desire
senses.zh: 强烈的浪漫爱情或性欲

example.en: Their early passion grew into a lasting love.
example.zh: 他们早年的激情发展成了持久的爱。

senses.en: a person who manages property or affairs for someone else

example.en: The estate hired a steward to manage the land.
example.zh: 庄园雇了一位管家来管理土地。

senses.en: a person who serves and looks after passengers on a ship or plane
senses.zh: （轮船、飞机上的）乘务员，服务员

example.en: The steward brought the passengers their drinks.
example.zh: 乘务员为乘客送来了饮品。

senses.en: a person who organizes or supervises an event

example.en: A steward guided us to our seats at the race.
example.zh: 赛事工作人员引导我们入座。

senses.en: impossible to avoid or prevent

example.en: Some delays during rush hour are unavoidable.
example.zh: 高峰时段的延误有些是不可避免的。

senses.en: a polite way of addressing a woman

example.en: May I help you, madam?
example.zh: 女士，请问需要帮忙吗？

senses.en: the woman who manages a brothel

example.en: The madam ran the house strictly.
example.zh: 这位老板娘把那家妓院管理得很严格。

senses.en: relating to or arranged around an axis

example.en: The engine's axial compressor pushes air straight along the shaft.
example.zh: 发动机的轴流式压气机沿轴直接推送空气。

senses.en: relating to the central axis of the body or a structure

example.en: An axial view of the spine shows the vertebrae in cross-section.
example.zh: 脊柱的轴位视图以横截面显示椎骨。

senses.en: a person who owns their home

example.en: The homeowner is responsible for repairing the roof.
example.zh: 房主有责任修理屋顶。

senses.en: to laugh quietly

example.en: She chuckled at the joke in the book.
example.zh: 她读到书里的笑话时轻声笑了。

senses.en: a quiet, soft laugh

example.en: He gave a chuckle as he read the cartoon.
example.zh: 他看漫画时轻笑了一声。

senses.en: a level or floor of a building

example.en: Our apartment is on the third storey of the building.
example.zh: 我们的公寓在这栋楼的第三层。

senses.en: the number 1

example.en: She has one brother and two sisters.
example.zh: 她有一个哥哥和两个姐姐。

senses.en: a person; any person in general

example.en: One should always be polite.
example.zh: 人人都应该有礼貌。

senses.en: a single person or thing; a particular but unspecified one

example.en: I'd like to buy one ticket.
example.zh: 我想买一张票。

senses.en: the number 1, or a single person or thing

example.en: Two is more than one.
example.zh: 二大于一。

senses.en: away from the inside of a place; outside

example.en: She went out to buy some food.
example.zh: 她出去买了一些食物。

senses.en: not lit or no longer burning; not at home or not available

example.en: When we woke up, the fire was out.
example.zh: 我们醒来时，火已经熄灭了。

senses.en: in baseball, when a batter or runner fails to reach base safely

example.en: There were two outs in the ninth inning.
example.zh: 第九局已经有两人出局了。

senses.en: to publicly reveal something, especially someone's identity or homosexuality
senses.zh: 公开揭露；公布（某人的身份或性取向）

example.en: The journalist decided to out the politician's secret dealings.
example.zh: 记者决定公开揭露那位政客的秘密交易。

senses.en: Great Britain; the island containing England, Scotland, and Wales; also often used loosely to mean the United Kingdom

example.en: She traveled across Britain by train last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天她乘火车游遍了不列颠。

senses.en: following the length of something

example.en: They walked along the river.
example.zh: 他们沿着河走。

senses.en: moving forward

example.en: The dog ran along beside us.
example.zh: 狗在我们旁边一路跑着。

senses.en: together with someone or something

example.en: Can I bring my friend along?
example.zh: 我可以带朋友一起来吗？

senses.en: the outside part or top layer of something

example.en: The surface of the table was scratched.
example.zh: 桌面被划花了。

senses.en: the outward appearance of a situation, as opposed to what lies beneath

example.en: On the surface, she seemed calm, but she was nervous.
example.zh: 表面上她显得平静，但其实很紧张。

senses.en: to rise up to the top of water, or to become known after being hidden

example.en: New evidence surfaced during the investigation.
example.zh: 调查期间出现了新的证据。

senses.en: unable to be found or no longer in your possession

example.en: I found my lost keys under the sofa.
example.zh: 我在沙发下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

senses.en: confused because you do not know where you are or what is happening

example.en: We got lost in the forest for two hours.
example.zh: 我们在森林里迷路迷了两个小时。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of lose; to no longer have something
senses.zh: 失去；丢失（lose 的过去式和过去分词）

example.en: She lost her job last month.
example.zh: 她上个月丢了工作。

senses.en: not won; defeated

example.en: They tried hard, but the game was lost.
example.zh: 他们很努力，但比赛还是输了。

senses.en: a business owned by two or more people who share its profits and responsibilities

example.en: They set up a partnership to run the restaurant together.
example.zh: 他们成立了一家合伙企业，共同经营这家餐厅。

senses.en: a cooperative relationship between people or groups working toward a shared goal

example.en: The two schools built a partnership to exchange teaching ideas.
example.zh: 这两所学校建立了合作关系，交流教学经验。

senses.en: far away from home or one's usual area

example.en: The young researcher travelled far afield to collect samples.
example.zh: 这位年轻的研究员远行各地采集样本。

senses.en: to officially reject or cancel a legal decision

example.en: The court quashed his conviction last year.
example.zh: 法院去年撤销了他的定罪。

senses.en: to put an end to something, especially by force

example.en: The government quickly quashed the rebellion.
example.zh: 政府迅速镇压了叛乱。

senses.en: a remark that is trite and lacks originality

example.en: His speech was full of empty platitudes.
example.zh: 他的演讲充满了空洞的陈词滥调。

senses.en: a plant with bright, showy red or orange flowers
senses.zh: 罂粟；虞美人（罂粟属植物）

example.en: Red poppies covered the field.
example.zh: 红色的罂粟花开满了田野。

senses.en: something good that happens by luck rather than skill

example.en: Winning the lottery was a complete fluke.
example.zh: 中彩票纯属偶然。

senses.en: a chemical element (P) that is common in living things and reactive; important in bones and fertilizers

example.en: Phosphorus is essential for plant growth.
example.zh: 磷对植物生长必不可少。

senses.en: different from what is considered normal or acceptable

example.en: The study examined deviant behavior among teenagers.
example.zh: 该研究考察了青少年中的偏差行为。

senses.en: a person whose behavior differs from what society accepts, especially sexually
senses.zh: 行为偏离常轨的人（常指性行为方面）

example.en: The novel portrays him as a social deviant.
example.zh: 这部小说把他描绘成一个行为偏离社会常轨的人。

senses.en: a person who regularly saves money

example.en: My mother was always a careful saver.
example.zh: 我母亲一直是个精打细算的节俭的人。

senses.en: something that saves time, money, or effort
senses.zh: 节省（时间、金钱等）的东西

example.en: This new app is a real time saver.
example.zh: 这个新应用真是省时的好帮手。

senses.en: an occasion when a group of people take part in sexual activity together

example.en: The novel mentions an orgy at a private party.
example.zh: 这部小说提到一次私人聚会上的群体性活动。

senses.en: an excessive amount of a particular activity

example.en: The sale turned into an orgy of spending.
example.zh: 这次促销变成了疯狂购物。

senses.en: the direction opposite east, where the sun sets

example.en: The sun sets in the west.
example.zh: 太阳从西方落下。

senses.en: located in or facing the west

example.en: The west door was locked.
example.zh: 西边的门锁着。

senses.en: toward the west

example.en: They drove west along the coast.
example.zh: 他们沿着海岸向西行驶。

senses.en: to rest or move on the surface of a liquid

example.en: The leaves float on the pond.
example.zh: 树叶漂浮在池塘上。

senses.en: to move slowly and lightly through air or space

example.en: A balloon floated across the sky.
example.zh: 一个气球飘过天空。

senses.en: a decorated vehicle in a parade

example.en: The parade featured a giant flower float.
example.zh: 游行中有一辆巨大的花卉花车。

senses.en: a small object that stays on water, used for support or signaling

example.en: The fishing line has a small float.
example.zh: 钓鱼线上有一个小浮子。

senses.en: a basic rule or idea that explains or guides something

example.en: The design follows the principle of simplicity.
example.zh: 这个设计遵循简洁的原则。

senses.en: a strong moral belief about right and wrong

example.en: She refused to lie because it went against her principles.
example.zh: 她拒绝撒谎，因为那违背她的原则。

senses.en: a natural law or scientific rule that explains how something works

example.en: The machine works on a simple physical principle.
example.zh: 这台机器依据一个简单的物理原理工作。

senses.en: a long journey, especially by sea or in space

example.en: The ship set out on a long voyage across the Pacific.
example.zh: 这艘船启程开始横渡太平洋的漫长航程。

senses.en: to make a long journey by sea

example.en: They voyaged across the ocean in a small sailing boat.
example.zh: 他们乘一艘小帆船横渡大洋。

senses.en: to behave according to rules, standards, or expectations

example.en: All products must conform to safety standards.
example.zh: 所有产品都必须符合安全标准。

senses.en: to change your behavior to fit in with others or with a situation

example.en: Teenagers often feel pressure to conform to their peers.
example.zh: 青少年常常感到要顺应同龄人的压力。

senses.en: to read something quickly, noting only the main points

example.en: I skimmed the article to get the main idea.
example.zh: 我略读了那篇文章，了解大意。

senses.en: to remove floating matter from the surface of a liquid, or to move lightly over a surface without touching it

example.en: She skimmed the cream off the milk.
example.zh: 她撇去了牛奶上的奶油。

senses.en: made from milk with the cream removed

example.en: He drinks skim milk for breakfast.
example.zh: 他早餐喝脱脂牛奶。

senses.en: a thin layer or film forming on the surface of a liquid

example.en: There was a skim of ice on the pond.
example.zh: 池塘表面结了一层薄冰。

senses.en: (British spelling) a thick rubber ring that fits around a wheel
senses.zh: 轮胎（英式拼写，美式拼作 tire）

example.en: The front tyre of my bike is flat.
example.zh: 我自行车的前轮胎瘪了。

senses.en: Tyre, a port city in southern Lebanon, an ancient Phoenician seaport
senses.zh: 泰尔（黎巴嫩南部港口城市，古代腓尼基海港）

example.en: Tyre was famous for its purple dye in ancient times.
example.zh: 泰尔在古代以其紫色染料闻名。

senses.en: a place where goods are sold, often at reduced prices

example.en: She bought a handbag at the factory outlet.
example.zh: 她在工厂折扣店买了一个手提包。

senses.en: a device in a wall where electrical appliances can be plugged in

example.en: Plug the lamp into the wall outlet.
example.zh: 把台灯插到墙上的插座里。

senses.en: a way of expressing or releasing feelings or energy

example.en: Running is a good outlet for stress.
example.zh: 跑步是缓解压力的好方式。

senses.en: to order someone not to do something

example.en: Her parents forbade her to stay out late.
example.zh: 她父母不许她在外面待到很晚。

senses.en: to make something impossible or prevent it from happening

example.en: The heavy rain forbade any outdoor activities.
example.zh: 大雨使任何户外活动都无法进行。

senses.en: having the properties of a magnet; able to attract iron or steel

example.en: The magnetic strip on the card stores data.
example.zh: 卡片上的磁条存储数据。

senses.en: very attractive or appealing; having a strong charm

example.en: She has a magnetic personality that draws people to her.
example.zh: 她有着吸引人的个性，让人们不由自主地靠近她。

senses.en: a short statement giving the main points of something

example.en: She wrote a summary of the report for the meeting.
example.zh: 她为会议写了一份报告摘要。

senses.en: done quickly, without the usual formalities

example.en: The rebels faced summary execution.
example.zh: 叛乱者面临着即决处决。

senses.en: a flat floating platform made of logs or other materials tied together

example.en: They crossed the river on a simple wooden raft.
example.zh: 他们乘一个简易木筏过了河。

senses.en: a very large number or amount of something

example.en: The government announced a raft of new measures.
example.zh: 政府宣布了一系列新措施。

senses.en: to travel or transport goods on a raft

example.en: They rafted down the wild river last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天他们乘筏顺湍急的河流而下。

senses.en: famous and admired by many people

example.en: The city is celebrated for its beautiful architecture.
example.zh: 这座城市以美丽的建筑而闻名。

senses.en: protected by metal plating or armor

example.en: An armored truck transported the money safely.
example.zh: 一辆装甲卡车安全地运送了这笔钱。

senses.en: having a hard protective covering (of animals)
senses.zh: 有硬壳保护覆盖的（动物）

example.en: The armadillo is an armored animal.
example.zh: 犰狳是一种有硬壳保护的动物。

senses.en: to be more important or valuable than something else

example.en: For our team, the benefits of the new system outweigh the costs.
example.zh: 对我们团队而言，新系统的收益大于成本。

senses.en: too much traffic in one place; crowding

example.en: Traffic congestion is bad during rush hour.
example.zh: 高峰时段交通拥堵严重。

senses.en: a blocked or stuffy state of the nose or lungs

example.en: He used a humidifier to relieve his nasal congestion.
example.zh: 他用加湿器缓解鼻塞。

senses.en: a thing or event that is very unusual and unexpected

example.en: The storm was a total freak of nature.
example.zh: 这场风暴完全是大自然的反常现象。

senses.en: a person who is extremely enthusiastic about something

example.en: My brother is a fitness freak who exercises every day.
example.zh: 我哥哥是个健身迷，每天锻炼。

senses.en: to become very worried, upset, or excited (informal)

example.en: Don't freak out, but I think we lost the tickets.
example.zh: 别慌，不过我觉得我们把票弄丢了。

senses.en: very unusual and unexpected

example.en: He was injured in a freak accident at work.
example.zh: 他在工作中一次离奇的事故中受了伤。

senses.en: the state of having a healthy, normal mind

example.en: The court questioned the defendant's sanity.
example.zh: 法庭质疑被告的精神是否健全。

senses.en: reasonable and sensible behavior or thinking

example.en: Let's hope some sanity returns to the debate.
example.zh: 希望辩论能恢复一些理智。

senses.en: a box where bees are kept

example.en: The beekeeper checked every hive for honey.
example.zh: 养蜂人检查了每个蜂箱里的蜂蜜。

senses.en: to calculate an amount incorrectly or judge a situation wrongly

example.en: We miscalculated the cost of the repairs.
example.zh: 我们算错了维修费用。

senses.en: not polite; rude

example.en: It was impolite of him to interrupt the speaker.
example.zh: 他打断演讲者是不礼貌的。

senses.en: complete and thorough; covering every detail

example.en: The report gives an exhaustive analysis of the market.
example.zh: 这份报告对市场进行了详尽的分析。

senses.en: the hot region of the Earth between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn

example.en: Many tropical birds live in the tropics.
example.zh: 许多热带鸟类生活在热带地区。

senses.en: to start a fire burning again

example.en: He rekindled the fire with dry wood.
example.zh: 他用干柴重新点燃了火。

senses.en: to bring back a feeling or relationship
senses.zh: 重新唤起，重燃（感情、关系等）

example.en: Their trip rekindled their old friendship.
example.zh: 这次旅行重燃了他们的旧日友谊。

senses.en: the process of keeping food or other things cold to preserve them

example.en: Refrigeration keeps food fresh for longer.
example.zh: 冷藏能让食物保鲜更久。

senses.en: small animals with six legs and a body in three parts, such as ants and flies

example.en: Many insects are attracted to flowers by their color.
example.zh: 许多昆虫被花的颜色吸引。

senses.en: working or studying for fewer hours than full time

example.en: She has a part-time job at a bookstore.
example.zh: 她在一家书店做兼职工作。

senses.en: for fewer than the usual number of hours
senses.zh: 兼职地；以部分时间方式

example.en: He works part-time while studying.
example.zh: 他边学习边做兼职。
